import './src/document-scroll-demo.ts'; const demo=document.querySelector('document-scroll-demo'); if(new URL(location.href).searchParams.has('element'))demo.elementMode=true; document.querySelector('#reveal').onclick=()=>demo.controller.scrollToKey('row-300',{behavior:'instant',block:'start'}); document.querySelector('#smooth').onclick=()=>demo.controller.scrollToKey('row-300',{behavior:'smooth',block:'start'}); document.querySelector('#heights').onclick=()=>{demo.large=!demo.large;}; document.querySelector('#preceding').onclick=()=>{const before=document.querySelector('#before');before.style.height=before.offsetHeight+180+'px';}; if(new URL(location.href).searchParams.has('progress-report')){const a=document.createElement('a');a.className='report';a.href='http://127.0.0.1:4177';a.textContent='Progress Report';document.body.append(a);}
